title: Ore Enchantments
description: Ore Enchantments — A mod that makes gold, iron, and copper mining easier.
body:
**Ore Enchantments**


```
This small mod adds three new enchantments for pickaxes:
```


- Irony – increases iron ore drops
  
- Gilding – increases gold ore drops
  
- Coppering – increases copper ore drops


```
This mod is perfect for those who are constantly faced with a shortage of resources such as gold, iron, and copper.
```
